content.short: Den is a Safe-based treasury interface for teams to hold, move and automate digital assets.
content.description: Den is a Safe-based platform for managing digital assets on newer L2 networks, including Hyperliquid. Teams use it to run shared treasuries where transactions need more than one signer. Its Frontier product focuses specifically on chains that standard Safe interfaces do not yet cover.
content.meta: Approval routing and automation layered onto Safe, for teams that outgrew a bare multisig.
